[ASSISTANT_SAID] The interview may begin with broad questions about mobile app experiences, followed by specific questions about social networking and productivity apps, concluding with overall impressions of the new mobile app.

[USER_SAID] The user requested content on types of questions, including definitions, examples, and advantages/disadvantages.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Open-ended questions allow detailed responses and are useful for gaining insights into user experiences.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Closed-ended questions provide limited response options and are useful for gathering quantitative data.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Probing questions are follow-up questions that help gain further insight into a participant's previous responses.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Each type of question has its advantages and disadvantages, impacting the quality of insights gathered during user interviews.
